Hi,

I reviewed your requirements for the Shopify continuous scraping pipeline and lightweight API.

Because Shopify stores natively expose structured catalog endpoints (/products.json and /products/<handle>.json), we don't need heavy, fragile headless browsers that get blocked. We can extract 100% of the structured data directly and cleanly.

Key Deliverables:
• Headless Scraper: Captures title, price, variants (size/color), stock levels, and full HTML description with pagination and rate-limit backoff.
• Lightweight Backend (FastAPI + SQLite):
  - GET /api/products (full catalog with search/filter)
  - GET /api/products?url=<url> (instant real-time product lookup)
  - GET /api/products/export.csv (one-click CSV download)
  - POST /api/refresh (manual on-demand sync)
• Web Dashboard: Clean, responsive UI with real-time search, instant refresh trigger button, and CSV export.
• Scheduled Cron Sync: Runs automatically on your chosen interval.
• VPS Deployment Guide & Full Source Code with inline comments.

Can deliver within 24 hours. Looking forward to discussing your target store domain!

Best regards,
Hardik Kakkad
